This prophecy appears to have two fulfillments. The first fulfillment would be when God brings the people of Israel back to their land. In this case, **the bearing one** would refer to “daughter Zion” [4:10](../04/10.md), who stands for the faithful remnant of Israel. She **gives birth** to the restored nation of Israel. The second and greater fulfillment is when the mother of the Messiah gives birth to him who is able to create the new, fully restored people of God, bringing together the remnant of Israel and all of **his brothers** redeemed from the rest of mankind. If possible, translate this in a way that can apply to both fulfillments.
The pronoun **his** refers to the ruler whom Yahweh has promised. It may be helpful to clarify this for your readers. Alternate translation: [and the remainder of that ruler’s brothers]

Micah is speaking of the fellow Israelites of this ruler as if they were his **brothers**. Your language may have a comparable expression that you can use in your translation, or you could state the meaning plainly. Alternate translation: [and the remainder of his fellow Israelites]
